notes.subject: ⟨nĩ⟩
notes.rationale: Aramaic pile-up אנתה מלכא מלך מלכיא lacks a copula; Gĩkũyũ needs nĩ to say 'thou art'

notes.subject: מלכא מלך מלכיא
notes.rationale: threefold repetition of 'king' (king-of-kings-of-kings) — the Aramaic stacking is flattened to two terms in Gĩkũyũ

notes.subject: Eroha
notes.rationale: Aramaic אלה (God) rendered with the Hebrew-sound form per the Names discipline, not the common word Ngai

notes.subject: Nebukadinecari
notes.rationale: Daniel addresses the king directly — second-person declaration of the dream's meaning

notes.subject: די
notes.rationale: rendered 'nĩrĩrĩa' (that/because); some versions make it 'unto whom', tying the gifts to the king rather than grounding the title

translation: We mwathi, ⟨nĩ⟩we mũthamaki wa aathamaki, nĩrĩrĩa Eroha wa igũrũ nĩakuheire kũrĩ-we ũthamaki, hinya, na kĩhooto, na kũgoocwo.
